name: Ore Tsuma! ~Ore ga Mansion Kanrinin ni Nattara Hitozuma-tachi to Chotto Ii Koto Dekichau kamo!?~
original_name: おれつま！ ～オレがマンション管理人になったら人妻たちとちょっとイイコトできちゃうかも!?～
source:
Kensuke dragged on the life of the unemployed, until one day he saw an ad in the newspaper:
"It is required - the manager; The salary is 200,000 yen per month; Housing will provide "
Not believing his eyes, he sent a resume. At the interview
Hero met a stunning girl who pounced on his penis.
After coition, she asked for forgiveness, and the hero,
Not understanding what was happening, had already thought of running away from here.
The next morning Kensuke received a call from this girl - he was hired.
His first task as a "manager" -
Remember the faces and names of all the girls who live here. A new life has begun.
translation: 健介一直过着无所事事的失业生活，直到有一天他在报纸上看到了一则广告：“招聘管理员；月薪20万日元；提供住房”。他不敢相信自己的眼睛，投了简历。在面试时，主人公遇到了一个扑向他下体的惊艳女孩。交合之后，她请求原谅，而主人公在不明白发生了什么的情况下已经想要逃离这里了。第二天早上，健介接到了这个女孩的电话——他被录用了。他作为“管理员”的第一个任务——记住所有住在这里的女孩的面孔和名字。新生活开始了。
